description: Header file defining functions, types, and constants for wireless channel management, including channel switching, configuration, and related data structures.

classes.name: wld_rad_chanChange_t
classes.description: Structure representing a radio channel change event, including source, target, reason, and statistics.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_init
methods.description: Initialize channel management for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_cleanup
methods.description: Cleanup resources associated with channel management for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_writeDfsChannels
methods.description: Write the current DFS channels to the PCB.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_reportCurrentChanspec
methods.description: Report the current channel specification with a reason.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_setTargetChanspec
methods.description: Set a target channel specification, optionally directly, with a reason.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_checkInitChannel
methods.description: Check and initialize the current channel.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getAutoBwExt
methods.description: Determine auto bandwidth extension based on mode, max bandwidth, and target channel.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getAutoBw
methods.description: Get automatic bandwidth for a target channel.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getBetterDefaultChannel
methods.description: Choose the better default channel between current and new.

methods.name: wld_chanmgt_getHighestApplicableRadBw
methods.description: Get the highest applicable radio bandwidth.
